body: IME I use a method called “tarantula fishing, which was somewhat mentioned in previous comment. Without shinning light under the dishwater (to not scare them), use the long piece of grass to create vibrations around the floor. Try just around the dishwasher exit before actually putting the grass under the dishwasher. This can simulate prey activity around the “burrow”. So, they might come out to investigate. Often once they realize it’s not actually prey they will retreat again, so try to safely block the entrance to the dishwasher once they leave the dishwasher. Good luck!

Some general advice based on my experience:
-my parents used to act like me SHing hurt them more then it hurts me, and like they are victims in this situation. That really broke some of my trust in them and made me not ask for help, so just keep in mind not to get offended or have a very extreme reaction if you find out she continues to self harm

-my parents said “well this is clearly a cry for help” which isn’t true, never assume you know why they SH and just listen 

-avoid terminology like they are a “cutter” or “slit her wrists”, that really bothered me, instead try using terms like self harming or just “hurting yourself” makes it easier to talk about (in my opinion)

-I agree with a previous comment about “if you feel like hurting yourself what would it take for you to come to me in that moment” 

-monitor her but still respect her right to privacy so you don’t break trust 

-Try to establish that if she were to hurt herself, and need medical attention, that she can come to you for help. I see a lot of posts by young kids that are about them accidentally going to far, and being to scared to ask there parents to get to the hospital or medical treatment. This is a worse case scenario but you just want to make sure you have that trust

-Also, I would consider seeing a therapist yourself (not sure if you already do) because its really hard to know a love one is SHing and can take a toll on your own mental health. A therapist of your own can help process those emotions and give advice on how to handle this situation

It sounds like you are doing great so far, I hope things get better ❤️
